question: How is all that is perceived by the senses characterized in relation to manifestation?
premises: All things can be perceived by the senses.
Manifestation is a possible quality of things.
Sense-perceived things are described as devoid of manifestation.
inference: Everything perceived by the senses is devoid of true manifestation.
uncertainties: The compound reading of prakāśaka vivarjitam is interpretive.
plain_english: All that is perceived by the senses is devoid of manifestation.
